notes: The 'Set ... in order' unit is the one judgment call: the ASV spends three words on the single imperative צַו and no word writes its lexeme, so the whole expression is that verb's under rule 30's one-rendering reading, headed on 'order' by rules 24 and 44 with 'Set' named as the competing head.
Both articles of בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם go unrepresented while הֵם takes the written 'those', exactly as rule 41 reads הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא → 'that place'.
לְ before מוּת takes the written 'unto' and the infinitive takes 'death'; each morpheme has a rendering of its own, so rule 2 splits rather than rule 30 fusing.
